newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka rubber prices strong on low demand.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka rubber prices strong on low demand.

text.p: Rubber prices were firm on Thursday on low quantity due to monsoon rains, traders said.
"Rains have prevented regular tapping in some areas for the last 30 days," said a trader at produce brokers Forbes & Walker.
Best latex one-x was unquoted, brokers said. Number one stayed at 83.50 rupees ($1.4) per kg. Sole crepe, which rose to 130 rupees a kg on high demand, was sold up to December, they said.
On offer was 149 tonnes, which was a below-average quantity, brokers said.
"Since quantities are seen falling further due to rain, there were a lot of forward sales," said the Forbes & Walker broker. ($1=58.9).
